query: I've finished a 70,000-word business history book. Please do a line and copy edit in Word with tracked changes so I can accept or reject each one.
Edit chapter 4 of my nonfiction manuscript: tighten it by about 12%, fix grammar and Chicago style, and keep a running style sheet.
My memoir chapters were partly drafted with AI and the voice is uneven. I need sentence-level editing plus consistency checks, delivered as a .docx with changes tracked.
Can you copyedit my trade nonfiction book on the history of semiconductors? Spellings of names, dates and in-text citations need to match the references.
Here's a 300-word blurb that sounds AI-written. Just make it sound more human.
Audit the writing of my journal article on enzyme kinetics and give me a list of prose issues by pass.
I want a full editorial review of my finished science book with a publish or don't-publish verdict.
